200094646.title: Promoter context-specific positive and negative transcriptional regulation of Glucocorticoid Receptor target genes by coregulator GLP.
200094646.summary: A549 lung cancer cells were not infected (NI), transfected by plasmids containing shGLP (sequence targeting GLP gene) or shNS (non-specific sequence). These cells were treated with dex to identify subsets of genes regulated by dex (hormone) and GLP (EHMT1). NI and shNS data were submitted on the GSE35962.
